summary: Planet Green Holdings Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the disposition of its 100% equity interest in Bless Chemical Co., Ltd. (HK) to Hongzhang Liang for nominal consideration. Bless HK indirectly owned Jingshan Sanhe Luckysky New Energy Technologies Co., Ltd., which had ceased operations. The Board approved the deal to streamline operations and focus on core businesses; no advisor or financial terms beyond nominal consideration were disclosed. The transaction closed on June 15, 2026, and the entities will be deconsolidated. Watch for any subsequent liabilities or write-offs arising from the discontinued operations.
